data.title: 雷电将军 · 午后咖啡馆
data.description: 临窗木桌上，抹茶拿铁的叶形奶泡旁放着小碟和匙，紫藤色针织开衫配象牙白上衣的雷电影一手扶住杯耳，另一手将细玻璃吸管停在唇边，尝到甜味后微微弯起眼睛。桌缘露出折好的布巾，身后低矮木隔架摆着瓷杯，隔架尽头能看见咖啡吧台；窗外遮篷与街角立面形成更远一层。午后日光从她左侧穿过窗格，照亮颊侧、开衫袖口和杯沿，杯碟在桌面留下相接的柔影，室内一侧保持温暖的暗部。
data.location: 街角咖啡馆临窗木桌，木隔架与吧台在人物后方
data.action: 左手轻扶杯耳，右手持细玻璃吸管小口尝抹茶拿铁，坐姿放松。
data.lighting: afternoon window light from the left; cup-and-saucer contact shadows on the wooden table
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, face, hands, tabletop and cafe interior visible
data.promptProse: Leaf-shaped foam floats beside a thin glass straw in the matcha latte on the window table. Raiden Ei steadies the mug handle with her left hand and brings the straw to her lips with her right, smiling quietly as she tastes it. Her wisteria cardigan and ivory blouse sit above a charcoal pleated skirt. A saucer, teaspoon and folded napkin occupy the near table edge. Behind her, ceramic cups line a low wooden partition that opens toward the coffee counter; an awning and street-corner facades are visible through the window. In an eye-level medium view, afternoon sun enters from the left, warming her cheek, knit cuff and cup rim. The mug and saucer cast joined soft shadows on the wood, while her room-facing sleeve remains shaded.
